verdict.rationale: Fastmail is an email service, so AI-drafted replies in the user's own voice are a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any AI drafting feature, voice or tone learning, or AI-generated reply suggestions. Templates are static user-written text, and the JMAP API is only a developer building block, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts replies in my own voice and tone — ready to review and send, not generic boilerplate
